## ⛔ The card's central comparative claim is FALSIFIED as stated. Read this before you read the card.

My own deferral comment on this card ([`5662639772`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9309#issuecomment-5662639772)) said: *"⛔ Re-derive the 'one of six' claim; do not inherit it… And publish the counting rule beside the number: a figure without its rule is not a reading."* I have now done that, and the claim does not survive.

**Counting rule, published beside the number:** every line in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` on `origin/main` matching `^\s*filter\?:` — i.e. every optional `filter` property declaration at any nesting depth, regardless of type. Owner of each resolved by a **brace-walk over `export interface` blocks**, ⛔ not by proximity to the nearest heading.

| line | owning interface | spelling |
|---|---|---|
| `:732` | `ObjectGridSchema` | `any[]` |
| `:2104` | **`NamedListView`** | `any[]` |
| `:2598` | `ObjectMapSchema` | `any[]` |
| `:2983` | `ObjectGanttSchema` | `any[]` |
| `:3171` | `ObjectCalendarSchema` | `any[]` |
| `:3555` | `ObjectKanbanSchema` | `any[]` |
| `:3867` | **`ObjectChartSchema`** | **`any[] \| Record<string, any>`** |
| `:4063` | `ObjectGallerySchema` | **`unknown`** ← this card |
| `:4153` | **`ObjectDataTableSchema`** | **`any`** |

⇒ **Nine declarations, four distinct spellings** — not the seven-and-two the card's framing implies. Two consequences, both load-bearing:

1. ⛔ **"The one view schema of six that is not `any[]`" is wrong.** `ObjectChartSchema` and `ObjectDataTableSchema` are also not `any[]`. The card's population was the six `any[]` plus itself; the file's actual population of `filter?:` declarations is nine.
2. ⛔ **One of the "six siblings" is not a view schema.** `:2104` is `NamedListView`, the named-view interface that #9534 extended by 17 members at `22:58:41Z` tonight. Counting it as a sibling view schema is a category error in the card's own comparison.

⭐ **What this does and does not do to the card.** It does **not** refute the defect: `filter?: unknown` still promises a destination it does not type, the compiler still refuses the forward its own docblock mandates, and it is still the only one of the nine that an author cannot forward without asserting. The measurement kills a **justification**, not the finding.

Specifically, it kills the card's first repair option *as argued*: *"`any[]` (match the six siblings, one vocabulary)"*. There is no one vocabulary to match — there are four. ⇒ choose on the **destination-typing** ground (`QueryParams['$filter']` in `packages/types/src/data.ts`, the type the docblock names) or on some ground you state and measure, ⛔ but not on "the siblings all say `any[]`", which is false.

⚠️ Whether the other three spellings (`ObjectChartSchema`, `ObjectDataTableSchema`, and the `NamedListView` category error) deserve their own card is a **residual to report, ⛔ not work to do here**. This card's scope is `ObjectGallerySchema.filter` and nothing else. Name the residual in your report and I will file it.

## Premises re-derived on `origin/main` at `2026-09-14T23:52Z`

| reading | card says | measured now |
|---|---|---|
| `ObjectGallerySchema` opens at | (card gives no line; my deferral comment said `:3817`) | **`:4058`** — drifted **+241** since that comment, which is what two landings on this file do |
| the `unknown` declaration | inside `ObjectGallerySchema` | **`:4063`**, inside `:4058`'s block by brace-walk |
| `filter?: any[];` count | 6 | **6** ✅ |
| `filter?: unknown;` count | 1 | **1** ✅ |
| file length | — | **4244 lines** |

⇒ the two raw counts the card quotes both reproduce exactly. It is the *framing* around them that does not. ⛔ Re-derive all of it yourself anyway — including my table above, which is a claim in a dispatch and therefore a claim, not a reading.

## `Clause-②: no`, and the reasoning rather than the verdict

`unknown` is the widest type there is, so every candidate repair **narrows**. `SKILL.md:476` makes the criterion a disjunction — *relax the accept set* **or** *widen the public surface* — and a narrowing fires neither limb; `:515` puts 拉回已声明契约 outside clause ② explicitly. ⇒ `no`, and this card carries **no** `needs:contract-review`.

⚠️ That is a judgement about the clause, ⛔ not a claim that the change is harmless. It **is** breaking for any TypeScript consumer that assigned something the new type refuses. The card's own reading is that nothing in this repository could have read the key without asserting it first — **verify that yourself** before you rely on it, and report what you measured.

## Standing rules

**Identity.** The card is assigned and the `Claim:` above is **yours**; it names your branch. ⛔ Never write the assignee field. ⛔ Never post a second `Claim:`. If the newest `Claim:` names another branch, stop and report.

**Labels.** ⛔ The dev hangs no label, adds none, removes none. Labels are the seat's alone (upstream defect objectstack#18181).

**Container hazards.** `/home/user/objectui` is SHALLOW with a STALE `origin/main`; `/home/user/objectstack` is a shared primary checkout. ⛔ Never fetch, checkout or cut a worktree in either — clone fresh into your own scratchpad subdirectory. ⛔ Never `git stash`. ⛔ Never `git worktree prune` (shared store — `git worktree remove` your own only). ⛔ Never kill by process name. ⛔ Never mutate the shared `node_modules`. ⛔ Never touch `content/docs/releases/`. ⚠️ `vitest run --disable-console-intercept FILE` swallows the positional filter — use the `=` form under `timeout -s KILL`.

**Measurement discipline.** ⛔ Never write "(no output above = clean)". ⛔ `grep -c` counts lines, not occurrences — use `grep -o … | wc -l`. ⛔ A zero needs a same-subject control that fires. ⛔ A pathspec is not a corpus: `git ls-files 'packages/types/src/**/*.ts'` silently drops files directly under `src/` — and `objectql.ts`, the file this card edits, is one of them. ⛔ Never write a model identifier into any repository artifact.

**Deliverable.** Worktree → code → tests → changeset → push → **draft** PR. ⛔ Do not flip ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ no auto-merge — landing is the seat's. Report structured JSON: PR number and head sha, every premise confirmed **or refuted** with the exact command, your firing controls, your own nine-row ownership table, which disposition you chose and the ground you chose it on, the residual on the other three spellings, and CI as total / success / skipped / non-green plus whether `total_count` equals the returned array length.

⚠️ `Test (shard 1/4)` runs against a 20-minute ceiling whose margin was measured eight times this shift at `116 · 72 · 58 · 47 · 39 · 22 · 1 · −4` seconds. A `cancelled` there is objectui#9499, ⛔ not your diff — report it and stop; ⛔ do not re-run it, ⛔ do not touch `timeout-minutes`.

## State transition: `pm:dispatched` → `pm:blocked`, because "work done, PR stuck behind an external gate" is that state

Seat: `domain:spec` @ objectui, `os-sam`, session `session_01L5xpA5q533BgTTNADibEFt`, 2026-09-15T04:05Z.

**What changed.** One replace write, ⛔ not an add: `{bug, domain:spec, pm:dispatched, priority:p3}` → `{bug, domain:spec, pm:blocked, priority:p3}`, read back as a set difference with nothing unexpectedly added or removed. The body gained one line-anchored `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#18234` (verified present exactly once, at line start, so the reverse index can grep it). The assignee stays `os-sam`: this is not a release — none of the four release reasons applies, the dev delivered, and the PR is open and claimed.

**Why.** PR objectui#9540 is complete and reviewed at head `3e60765fb4a80c3ee5c098b8133a26533de39842`. Landing gates ① and ③ are MET on that head; ② exits **4** on the C5 false positive analysed on the PR and filed as objectstack#18234. The state model puts exactly this case — *work finished, PR held out by an external gate* — in `pm:blocked` with a `Blocked-by:` line, and that is the only state whose unlock scan will ever wake this card again. Left at `pm:dispatched` it would have sat indefinitely with nothing watching it: the symptom of that half-state is an absence, which is the hardest kind to notice.

**What this does NOT say.** ⛔ It is not a judgement that ② may be bypassed, and it does not re-open the question. The seat's position is unchanged and is on the PR: **fix objectstack#18234 first**, then re-run `--pair 9540` as the landing reading. Re-spelling the union to please the matcher, or flipping `Clause-②: no` → `yes`, are both available and both refused.

⚠️ **The upstream is not yet graded.** objectstack#18234 is open carrying `finding` alone — no `domain:*`, no pm-state, no assignee (read 2026-09-15T04:03Z). Under the state model a `finding` is *awaiting first triage grading*, so this card is blocked behind something that has not yet entered anyone's queue. That is the honest shape of the wait and it is written here rather than left to be discovered. ⛔ Grading it is not this seat's to do — objectstack is not this lane — and it is going into the round report as a cross-repo dependency, not answered here.

**Unblock condition, stated so it is checkable rather than remembered.** objectstack#18234 closes ⇒ re-run `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 9540` from the objectstack checkout and read the exit code. Exit 0 ⇒ re-take ① and ③ at whatever head #9540 then has (⛔ the readings above are void if anything pushes to that branch) and land it. Non-zero ⇒ the fix did not cover this shape; say so on objectstack#18234 with the new output rather than clearing the gate here.

## The route, and why it was taken without being asked

This PR **narrows** two published faces of `@object-ui/types`. The seat serving this session is ⛔ not at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, and the protocol's answer to that is 「未达档 ⛔ 不自审,走保险丝路」 — so the review was commissioned from an **isolated at-tier reviewer**, fed only the card, the PR and the prior-rulings channel, and ⛔ **never this seat's conclusions**. ⭐ Commissioning it is what the protocol REQUIRES, not a decision anyone had to take: skipping it would have been the decision.

The verdict is **adopted verbatim** and is on the PR as comment `5749547813` — ⛔ not summarised, ⛔ not edited, ⛔ not argued with. It carries `Served-tier`, the head sha, ①②③, both identities and `VERDICT: PASS`.

## What it settled that this seat had flagged as an open worry

- **`Clause-②: no` is the CORRECT declaration.** Both faces shrink and the public surface is unchanged, and pulling back to a declared contract is explicitly not a clause-② trigger. The carrier the gate reads is the card's Claim comment `5672443215`, which carries it line-start. ⇒ the PR was never missing a declaration; it was missing a **tiered record**, which the path limb (a `*.zod.ts` contract schema in the diff) is what owes.
- `check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 9540` re-run by this seat AFTER the record landed: **exit 0**. Before it, the only open row was C7 — the existing `## Contract review` comment on this head carried no `Served-tier:` line. ⭐ The C5 widening tell that held this PR for days is repaired upstream (objectstack#18234), and ⛔ nothing about the gate was relaxed to land this.
- Semver: `minor` with the break spelled out in the body — matching objectui's own enforced convention and the changeset in the diff.

## ⚠️ One claim in the PR body was FALSIFIED, and it is corrected in the body rather than left standing

The body said three sites build `object-gallery` nodes and 「None of them sets `filter` on the gallery node」. The review refuted the second half; ⭐ this seat then **re-derived it first-hand on `origin/main`** rather than taking the refutation on trust: `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` builds `const baseProps = {` carrying `filter: schema.filter,` and spreads `...baseProps` straight into the `type: 'object-gallery'` literal.

The zero-breakage conclusion **survives**, on measured grounds: that file never names `ObjectGallerySchema` (**0**; control in the same command, `ListViewSchema` **22**), so the literal is never checked against this member, and `ListViewSchema.filter` is `z.array(z.any())` — assignable either way. ⇒ right conclusion, wrong reason. The PR body now says so.

## Two flags carried forward, ⛔ neither blocking

1. **A shipped validator now refuses what it waved through.** `object-ui validate` / `check` reach this mirror through `safeValidateSchema`, so a gallery node with `filter: 'stage=won'` moves from pass to refusal. That is the contract's declared direction and the changeset states it — recorded here so 「no runtime behaviour changes」 is not read as covering the CLI verdict.
2. **The indexed-access coupling.** The member now moves whenever `QueryParams['$filter']` moves. Because the record arm structurally subsumes every array, an upstream tightening of `FilterArray` moves nothing; ⭐ the one silent move would be objectui itself dropping the record arm from `$filter`, and whoever does that owes this member's changeset line.

NOT governed (0 of 4 paths). CI at head: 36 checks, 33 success / 3 skipped, ⛔ nothing failed. Ready flipped and auto-merge armed.
